answer: An hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The gale counter is kept in grove and ivory exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 40 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
